quote: Invenergy LLC (“Invenergy”) announced today that it has purchased the La Jacinta Solar Farm in Uruguay from Fotowatio Renewable Ventures (FRV), the developer of the solar farm which has been operating since October 2015. … La Jacinta has an installed capacity of 64 MW of power from 216,000 solar panels manufactured by BYD.
note: Opened Invenergy 14 Mar 2017 (La Jacinta purchase); ownership reconfirmed in 2024 Cardal release.
